title: Subscription entitlement migration and overage smoothing - acceptance criteria and billing runbook
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Goal: migrate existing customers from legacy per-call quota tables to the new entitlement model while ensuring no unexpected bill shocks. Deliver a billing runbook that smooths overage impacts during the migration window and provides deterministic proration, with clear acceptance criteria and rollback controls. This ticket covers product requirements, acceptance criteria, and operations runbook for cutover and post-migration reconciliation.
acceptance_criteria: No data loss: every active customer’s historical usage and remaining credits are migrated with <= 0.1% reconciliation variance compared to legacy system within 48 hours post-cutover.

Soft-overage smoothing: for customers who exceed quotas during the 30-day migration window, overage charges are capped at 25% of computed overage with automatic credit backfill applied within first invoice cycle.

Deterministic proration: plan upgrades/downgrades during migration must compute pro-rata credits/charges identical to legacy rules for 99.9% of transactions, and any deviation flagged for manual review.
Visibility: Console exposes a migration badge and per-tenant migration state with estimated final entitlements, and billing preview shows projected invoice differences prior to final billing run.
Rollback path: automated rollback to legacy quota enforcement can be performed within a 72-hour window with documented steps and a verified no-loss verification checklist.
Auditability: KMS-wrapped audit logs for entitlements and billing adjustments are emitted to the customer’s audit stream and retained per compliance retention policy.
Performance: migration process must complete for a mid-market customer (<= 100k monthly tokens) in under 2 hours with no more than 2 minutes of elevated error rate on control plane APIs.
Stakeholder sign-off: Finance, Billing Ops, Legal, and Security have approved the acceptance checklist and runbook before production cutover.
scope_changes: Initial scope included automatic full-balance conversion; changed to phased conversion with preview step due to edge cases for legacy usage credits.
Removed per-caller concurrency entitlements from this migration scope; will be handled in a follow-up (PM-142900) to reduce surface area.
Added 'overage smoothing' policy for first 30 days post-migration to reduce customer impact; this is timeboxed and reversible.
Decided to keep SKU aliasing translation rules for three legacy plans to avoid customer-facing plan name changes during cutover.
